defects: Adds unnecessary/stronger hypothesis [CommSemiring k] instead of gold's [Semiring k], restricting the theorem to commutative semirings
Adds unnecessary/stronger hypothesis [Group G] instead of gold's [MulOneClass G], restricting the theorem to groups instead of the more general class of types with a multiplicative identity
